example_sentences_in_bangla: এই বইয়ের পান্ডুলিপিতে অনেক কাটাকুটি হয়েছে।
তার লেখায় সম্পাদকের কাটাকুটি দেখে অবাক হলাম।
example_sentences_in_english: The manuscript of this book has undergone a lot of cutting and editing.
I was surprised by the heavy cuts made by the editor in his writing.
note: This idiom is commonly used in contexts of textual revision in Bengali literature.
